1. (S) SITUATION:
The convoy corridor has reopened, but a Soviet raider detachment is pressing into the Timor Sea against a coalition support screen. Darwin-based air elements must disrupt the enemy attack before the escort line is overwhelmed. The surface screen is outnumbered and depends on timely air cover and reconnaissance, with F-4Es available for limited strike support if required.
2. (S) MISSION: 2.1 Destroy the Soviet raider detachment. 2.2 Coalition support screen must survive.
3. (S) EXECUTION: 3.1 Launch surveillance and fighter sorties from Darwin to establish the enemy's position and movement axis. 3.2 Maintain fighter coverage over the support corridor and pressure hostile air activity around the escort line, using any available F-4E strike capability when the situation warrants. 3.3 Use patrol aircraft to maintain continuous surveillance and keep the raider detachment under observation. 3.4 Destroy the raider detachment before it can close with the support screen. Keep the escort line intact throughout the engagement.
4. (S) ENEMY SITUATION: 4.1 The Soviet detachment is operating on the marked raider axis and may be supported by reconnaissance aircraft. 4.2 Enemy surface units may attempt to force the support screen to concentrate while aircraft attack from outside the screen. 4.3 Expect the enemy to exploit any gap created by a diverted escort.
5. (S) FRIENDLY SITUATION: 5.1 Darwin air base is the launch and recovery point for the operation. 5.2 Fighter and patrol aircraft, including F-4Es with limited strike capability, are assigned to the air effort. 5.3 A coalition surface support screen is holding the marked area and must remain operational.
6. (S) INTEL ASSESSMENT: 6.1 Dry-season visibility supports long-range radar surveillance and coordinated fighter and patrol operations. 6.2 The enemy will attempt to overwhelm the screen before air power can be concentrated. Time to first effective pressure is critical. 6.3 Do not expend aircraft on isolated targets if the support screen is under immediate threat. Preserve the screen first, then complete the destruction of the raider detachment.
